input: Set up a capsule pantry with long-shelf staples

gold.taskTitle: Build a Capsule Pantry With Long-Shelf Staples
gold.taskDescription: Set up a curated, minimal pantry stocked with versatile, long-shelf-life staple ingredients for reliable everyday cooking.

questions.title: How many people is this pantry feeding regularly?
questions.description: Understanding household size helps determine quantities and storage scale needed.

questions.title: What cuisines or cooking styles do you cook most often?
questions.description: Knowing preferred cuisines shapes which staples are actually essential versus unnecessary.

questions.title: Do you have any dietary restrictions or allergies to work around?
questions.description: Restrictions such as gluten-free, vegan, or nut allergies will exclude certain standard staples.

questions.title: How much physical storage space do you currently have available?
questions.description: Cabinet size, shelf count, and pantry dimensions determine how expansive the setup can realistically be.

questions.title: What is your total budget for stocking this pantry?
questions.description: A defined budget determines how many items can be purchased at once versus phased in over time.

questions.title: Are you starting from scratch or reorganizing an existing pantry?
questions.description: Knowing the starting point affects whether an audit, purge, or full shop is the first step.

questions.title: Do you prefer to shop in-store, online, or both for this?
questions.description: Shopping method influences sourcing strategy, bulk-buying options, and delivery timelines.
